Supplemental Table 2. Task-type (Ignore vs Update) effects in the full sample
```{r tasktype_full_sample, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Full-sample sensitivity for the task-type (Ignore vs Update) effects reported in the
## main text (which use the n=26 two-session crossover sample). Here we pool ALL
## tremor-dominant patients and ALL their available trials -- adding the one-session /
## excluded patients -- with NO drug term, matching how the full-sample pupil task-effect
## models (Figure 3A) treat sessions. Deviation-coded type_dev (Update +0.5, Ignore -0.5),
## so its coefficient is the marginal Update-vs-Ignore effect. Performance error and RT are
## LMMs; high-effort choice (nr+sz pooled) is a binomial GLMM (task_dev = nr vs sz nuisance).
tt_perf <- cw_data_char %>% dplyr::filter(tremor_group == 'Yes', !is.na(dev)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effort_dev = ifelse(setSize == 3, 0.5, -0.5),
                type_dev   = ifelse(as.character(type) == 'Update', 0.5, -0.5))
tt_choice <- effort_choice_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type_dev = ifelse(as.character(type) == 'Update', 0.5, -0.5),
                task_dev = ifelse(task_name == 'sz', 0.5, -0.5))
m_tt_dev <- lmerTest::lmer(dev ~ effort_dev*type_dev + scale(updrs_total) + scale(Age) + Gender + (1|subNo),
                           data = tt_perf, control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa'))
m_tt_rt  <- lmerTest::lmer(rt  ~ effort_dev*type_dev + scale(updrs_total) + scale(Age) + Gender + (1|subNo),
                           data = tt_perf %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(rt)), control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa'))
m_tt_ch  <- glmer(chose_high_effort ~ type_dev + task_dev + scale(easyOffer) + scale(updrs_total) + scale(Age) + Gender + (1|subNo),
                  data = tt_choice, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa', optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
tt_row <- function(m, lab, logistic = FALSE){ co <- summary(m)$coefficients; r <- 'type_dev'
  # lmerTest lmer cols = Estimate, Std.Error, df, t value, Pr; glmer = Estimate, Std.Error, z value, Pr.
  # Pick the test-statistic column by name so we report t/z, not df.
  stat_col <- if ('t value' %in% colnames(co)) 't value' else if ('z value' %in% colnames(co)) 'z value' else 3
  b <- co[r,1]; s <- co[r,2]; st <- co[r, stat_col]; p <- if (logistic) 2*pnorm(-abs(st)) else co[r, ncol(co)]
  est <- if (logistic) sprintf('OR = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]', exp(b), exp(b-1.96*s), exp(b+1.96*s))
         else           sprintf('%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]', b, b-1.96*s, b+1.96*s)
  data.frame(Outcome = lab, `Subjects` = lme4::ngrps(m)[['subNo']],
             `Update vs Ignore` = est, Statistic = sprintf('%s = %.2f', if(logistic)'z' else 't', st),
             p = ifelse(p < .001, '< .001', sub('^0','', sprintf('%.3f', p))), check.names = FALSE) }
tasktype_full <- rbind(
  tt_row(m_tt_dev, 'Performance error (degrees)'),
  tt_row(m_tt_rt,  'Reaction time (s)'),
  tt_row(m_tt_ch,  'High-effort choice', logistic = TRUE))
cat('\n=== Task-type (Update vs Ignore) effects, FULL tremor-dominant sample ===\n'); print(tasktype_full, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tasktype_full, file.path(deriv_dir, 'tasktype_full_sample.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
kt_tt <- kable(tasktype_full, format = 'html', align = c('l','c','c','c','c'),
      caption = 'Supplemental Table 2. Task-type (Update vs Ignore) effects in the full sample') %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = 'Cambria') %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(general = 'All patients, all available sessions; no drug term. Positive error/RT = higher for Update; OR > 1 = greater willingness to exert effort for Update.',
                       general_title = 'Note. ', footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
# render a PNG (guarded) so it saves to figures/ like the other supplemental tables;
# add a rule under the title and above the Note, matching Table 1's styling.
tryCatch({
  tmp_tt <- tempfile(fileext = '.html')
  full_tt <- paste0('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">',
                    '<style>caption{text-align:left !important;padding-left:0;',
                    'border-bottom:1.5px solid #000;padding-bottom:5px;margin-bottom:2px;}',
                    'tfoot td{border-top:1.5px solid #000 !important;padding-top:5px;}</style></head><body>',
                    as.character(kt_tt), '</body></html>')
  ctt <- file(tmp_tt, encoding = 'UTF-8'); writeLines(full_tt, ctt, useBytes = FALSE); close(ctt)
  webshot::webshot(paste0('file:///', gsub('\\\\', '/', normalizePath(tmp_tt))),
                   file.path(deriv_dir, 'figures', 'supplemental_table_2_task-type_full_sample.png'),
                   zoom = 2, selector = 'table')
  unlink(tmp_tt)
}, error = function(err) cat('Supp Table 2 PNG render skipped:', conditionMessage(err), '\n'))
kt_tt
```

Supplemental Table 6 & Figure. Exploratory correlations of the propranolol effects with clinical measures
```{r drug_symptom_correlations, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## EXPLORATORY: does the size of each propranolol effect scale with disease burden? The
## per-subject drug effect = the drug_dev slope from each already-fitted model
## (coef(model)$subNo['drug_dev']): motivation (effort_drug_int), performance error (devL),
## reaction time (rtLni). Correlated with each clinical measure using KENDALL's tau (rank,
## robust to outliers, appropriate for small n and ordinal/skewed clinical scores).
## Exploratory and uncorrected; predictors are collinear (UPDRS / LEDD / disease duration).
psc_de <- function(m){ cs <- coef(m)$subNo['drug_dev']; data.frame(subNo = as.numeric(rownames(cs)), eff = cs[,1]) }
de_effs <- list('Motivation (high-effort choice)' = psc_de(effort_drug_int),
                'Performance error'               = psc_de(devL),
                'Reaction time'                   = psc_de(rtLni))
de_sym <- part_char %>% dplyr::transmute(subNo = as.numeric(SubNr),
  `MDS-UPDRS III` = as.numeric(UPDRS_total),
  `MDS-UPDRS III tremor subscore` = as.numeric(UPDRS_total_tremor),
  `MDS-UPDRS III non-tremor subscore` = as.numeric(UPDRS_total_non_tremor),
  `MMSE` = as.numeric(MMSE_score),
  `LEDD (mg)` = as.numeric(LEDD),
  `Disease duration (years)` = as.numeric(Disease_duration))
de_symcols <- setdiff(names(de_sym), 'subNo')
ktau <- function(x, y){ d <- data.frame(x, y); d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d), ]
  k <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$x, d$y, method = 'kendall'))
  c(tau = unname(k$estimate), p = k$p.value, n = nrow(d)) }
de_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(de_effs), function(en){ dat <- dplyr::left_join(de_effs[[en]], de_sym, by = 'subNo')
  do.call(rbind, lapply(de_symcols, function(s){ v <- ktau(dat$eff, dat[[s]])
    data.frame(effect = en, symptom = s, n = v['n'], tau = round(v['tau'],3), p = round(v['p'],4), row.names = NULL) })) }))
con_ds <- file(file.path(deriv_dir, 'drug_symptom_kendall.csv'), encoding = 'UTF-8')
write.csv(de_long, con_ds, row.names = FALSE)
cat('\n=== Propranolol effect x clinical measure (Kendall tau) ===\n'); print(de_long, row.names = FALSE)

# --- Supplemental Table 6: matrix rows = clinical measure, cols = drug effect, cell = tau (p) ---
pfmt_ds <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, '< .001', sub('^0', '', sprintf('%.3f', p)))
de_mat <- de_long %>% dplyr::mutate(cell = sprintf('%.2f (%s)', tau, pfmt_ds(p))) %>%
  dplyr::select(effect, symptom, cell) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = effect, values_from = cell)
de_mat <- de_mat[match(de_symcols, de_mat$symptom), ]; names(de_mat)[1] <- 'Clinical measure'
kt_ds <- kable(de_mat, format = 'html', align = c('l','c','c','c'),
      caption = 'Supplemental Table 6. Correlations of the propranolol effects with clinical measures') %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = 'Cambria') %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = '6cm') %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(general = 'Values are Kendall’s τ (p). Each cell correlates the per-subject propranolol effect (drug slope from the corresponding mixed model) with the clinical measure; n = 24 (motivation) or 26 (performance error, reaction time). Exploratory and uncorrected for multiple comparisons.',
                       general_title = 'Note. ', footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
tryCatch({
  tmp_ds <- tempfile(fileext = '.html')
  full_ds <- paste0('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">',
                    '<style>caption{text-align:left !important;padding-left:0;',
                    'border-bottom:1.5px solid #000;padding-bottom:5px;margin-bottom:2px;}',
                    'tfoot td{border-top:1.5px solid #000 !important;padding-top:5px;}</style></head><body>',
                    as.character(kt_ds), '</body></html>')
  cds <- file(tmp_ds, encoding = 'UTF-8'); writeLines(full_ds, cds, useBytes = FALSE); close(cds)
  webshot::webshot(paste0('file:///', gsub('\\\\', '/', normalizePath(tmp_ds))),
                   file.path(deriv_dir, 'figures', 'supplemental_table_6_drug_symptom_correlations.png'),
                   zoom = 2, selector = 'table')
  unlink(tmp_ds)
}, error = function(err) cat('Supp Table 6 PNG render skipped:', conditionMessage(err), '\n'))

# --- Supplemental Figure: scatter of per-subject drug effect vs each clinical measure,
# one PNG per drug effect, all six measures faceted, dashed zero line, Kendall tau annotated. ---
de_mk <- function(dfobj, ylab, col, fname){
  dat  <- dplyr::left_join(dfobj, de_sym, by = 'subNo')
  long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(dat, dplyr::all_of(de_symcols), names_to = 'measure', values_to = 'value') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = de_symcols))
  ann <- do.call(rbind, lapply(de_symcols, function(s){ v <- ktau(dat$eff, dat[[s]])
    data.frame(measure = factor(s, levels = de_symcols),
               label = sprintf('Kendall τ = %.2f\np = %s', v['tau'], pfmt_ds(v['p']))) }))
  p <- ggpubr::ggscatter(long, x = 'value', y = 'eff', add = 'reg.line', conf.int = TRUE,
                 add.params = list(color = col, fill = 'grey85'), color = col, size = 2.2, alpha = .65,
                 facet.by = 'measure', scales = 'free_x') +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', colour = 'grey65', linewidth = .35) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = ann, ggplot2::aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.25, size = 3.1, colour = 'grey25', lineheight = .95) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = 'Clinical measure', y = ylab) +
    ggplot2::theme(strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = 'bold', size = 10.5),
                   axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
                   panel.spacing = ggplot2::unit(0.9, 'lines'))
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(deriv_dir, 'figures', fname), plot = p, height = 6, width = 10.5, dpi = 150) }
de_mk(de_effs[[1]], 'Propranolol effect on high-effort choice (logit)', '#e41e52', 'drug_motivation_symptom_scatter.png')
de_mk(de_effs[[2]], 'Propranolol effect on performance error (degrees)', '#126192', 'drug_error_symptom_scatter.png')
de_mk(de_effs[[3]], 'Propranolol effect on reaction time (s)',           '#2ca02c', 'drug_rt_symptom_scatter.png')
```
